en_notification_subject_1: You have received a legally-binding communication from
en_aar_subtitles_1: Access the documents online now by following the instructions, or if you prefer, collect the documents in paper form at one of the SEND pickup points (CAF and other partner businesses). Please note that the content of the communication will produce legal effects for you even if you do not review it.
en_access_to_document_title: Access the documents online for free
en_access_to_document_1_pf: Scan the QR code with the IO app or your device's camera. Alternatively, go to the website
en_access_to_document_1_pg: Scan the QR code with your device's camera or go to the website
en_access_to_document_2: Log in and download the documents: they contain important information concerning you
en_access_to_document_3: If a payment is required, you can pay online or through pagoPA-enabled channels. The amount will be updated with notification costs: €2 for digital notifications, higher for registered post, which is only sent if no digital channels are available or if you do not open the communication in time
en_send_refinement: This document is a legally-binding communication inviting you to review the documents notified to you, which will have consequences for you in any case. If a payment is required, the amount to be paid will depend on the method you choose to access the notification, the type of registered post sent to you as chosen by the institution, and the number of delivery attempts. You have 120 days from the date on which the notification becomes legally valid to access the documents online or pick them up in person. After 120 days, the documents will no longer be available and you will have to contact the institution that sent them. Find out more about how to calculate the timing at
en_retrieve_copy: Pick up the documents in person
en_retrieve_copy_1: Find the SEND pickup point nearest to you at
en_retrieve_copy_title_list: Go to the pickup point bringing with you
en_retrieve_copy_list_4: a document certifying your role as legal representative
en_retrieve_copy_3: Pay €1.40 (plus VAT if applicable) for printing and document collection. Any costs for additional services rendered by the business are not included in the printing and collection service
en_disclaimer_caf: If a pagoPA notice is present, you can pay through all enabled channels. The amount will be updated with notification costs: €2 for digital notifications, higher for registered post, which is only sent if no digital channels are available or if you do not open the communication in time.
en_delegate_title: Do you want someone to pick up the documents for you?
en_delegate_body: to pick up the notified documents
en_delegate_title_list: The delegated person must bring with them
en_delegate_list_1: this notice with the delegation section completed and signed
en_delegate_list_4: a copy or the original of the fiscal code and an identity document of the delegating party
en_delegate_list_5: a document certifying the role of legal representative of the delegating party
en_io_content: If you have an Electronic ID card (CIE), you can ask a person you trust to access the online documents for you. They simply need to scan the QR code with IO and follow the instructions on the app to consult the documents on your behalf.
